Alex Chen: quick heads-up — follow-up on the fused-QKV + rope/bias fusion RFC. want to lock the runtime handshake and a canary plan. cc @Priya Rao @Benji Morales
Priya Rao: +1. main concerns are deterministic parity across kernels and quantization interactions. also: telemetry for silent regressions.
Benji Morales: summary from offline tests: fused QKV + rope-bias fusion looks great perf-wise, but we saw tiny output diffs when combined with bf16/4-bit quant. need a gating strategy.
Maya Singh: runtime note — current kernel selector keys on string flags per-model which leads to N x M combinatorics for path variants. we'd prefer a compact capability bitmask on the model manifest to keep selector simple.
Alex Chen: propose capability bitmask + deterministic fallback chain. sketch: 
```
# capability bits
CAP_QKV_FUSED = 1<<0
CAP_ROPE_FUSED = 1<<1
CAP_DROPOUTLESS = 1<<2
# model manifest example
model_cap = CAP_QKV_FUSED | CAP_ROPE_FUSED
# selection pseudocode
if model_cap & CAP_QKV_FUSED and hw_supports('fused_qkv'):
    use_kernel('fused_qkv')
else:
    use_kernel('split_qkv')
```
Benji Morales: FYI we hit a regression in nightly parity on llama-2-13b (small but above threshold). snippet: 
```
[eval] model=llama-2-13b test=wiki mean_lp_diff=2.1e-6 threshold=1e-7 -> FAIL
trace: mismatch at layer 8 kv_cache_offset=128
```
Priya Rao: that's why we need two controls: 1) an opt-in manifest capability from model onboarding and 2) runtime eval gating. if parity > thresh, emit telemetry event `fusion_parity_regression` and auto-disable fused path for that model version.
Maya Singh: canary rollout plan proposal:
- create dedicated canary pool `fusion-canary-###` (2xA100)
- run 10k sampled requests from production traces through fused kernels
- run token-level parity checks against split-kernel baseline for a sampled subset
- monitor mean_lp_diff, lat variance, kv-cache integrity metrics
- automatic rollback if parity fails or error rate delta > 0.1%
Alex Chen: sounds good. infra: can you spin up a canary and tag it? also need an API contract doc: `runtime.handshake.v1` with capability bits, kernel ABI version, and fallback order.
infra-bot: creating pool... provisioning requested.
infra-bot: done — pool `fusion-canary-03` created, 2xA100, tags=[canary,fused-qkv], region=us-west-2.
ci-bot: added `fused-attn-parity` job to CI matrix. runs nightly and on model-manifest changes. will post results to #eng-runtime/tests.
Benji Morales: one more: quantization teams — please run your calibrations with fused kernels enabled. we should add small unit tests that exercise kv cache offsets and rope application with and without bias fusion.
Priya Rao: add doc checklist for model onboarding: manifest bits, eval parity job, threshold, allowed quant modes. I'll draft it.
Alex Chen: great. I'll write the runtime.handshake.v1 draft and drop into /docs/runtime/handshake.md. next steps: Priya drafts onboarding checklist, Benji adds kv/rope unit tests, Maya wires canary metrics and rollback hooks.
Priya Rao: :thumbsup:
